text:
Which statement is correct?
A
A transformer is used to step up the voltage so that current is transmitted more efficiently.
B
A transformer is used to step up the current so that power is transmitted more efficiently.
C
A transformer is used to step up the voltage so that power is transmitted more efficiently.
D
A transformer is used to step up the current so that voltage is transmitted more efficiently.

options.label: A
options.text: A transformer is used to step up the voltage so that current is transmitted more efficiently.

options.label: B
options.text: A transformer is used to step up the current so that power is transmitted more efficiently.

options.label: C
options.text: A transformer is used to step up the voltage so that power is transmitted more efficiently.

options.label: D
options.text: A transformer is used to step up the current so that voltage is transmitted more efficiently.
